avatar.name: The Puppy Blues Parent
avatar.description: A millennial first-time puppy owner who is chronically sleep-deprived, overwhelmed by crate-crying, and silently harboring intense guilt for regretting their decision to get a dog.
avatar.awareness_notes: Problem-aware: knows the puppy has separation anxiety, but falsely believes 'cry it out' or heavy sedatives like CBD are the only options.

pain_points.description: Lying awake at 3 AM listening to the puppy scream and dig at the crate, feeling their own heart race, torn between comforting the dog and ruining their training.
examples: I just lie there staring at the ceiling while he screams, feeling like a complete failure.
I haven't slept more than 3 hours in a row since we brought her home.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: The sickening anxiety of putting on shoes and watching the puppy start to panic, knowing they will return to destroyed baseboards and pee on the floor.
examples: I literally tiptoe out the front door so he doesn't hear my keys jingle.
I can't even go to the grocery store without checking the puppy cam every five minutes.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: The deep, shameful guilt of looking at this puppy they wanted so badly and wishing they could just give it back and have their old, peaceful life return.
examples: I love him, but I miss my old life. I feel like a monster for thinking that.
I cry in the bathroom because I feel so overwhelmed and trapped.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

Relationship tension with partner over who handles the dog
Crushing guilt and feelings of inadequacy

product_fit.mechanism: A chewable treat combining L-theanine (an amino acid that promotes alpha brain waves) and gut-brain axis probiotics to biologically lower systemic cortisol without sedatives.
product_fit.how_it_resolves: Biologically shifts the puppy's nervous system out of 'fight or flight' panic into relaxed alertness within 30 minutes, allowing them to self-soothe in the crate.
product_fit.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

psychosocial_currencies_candidates.why_it_applies: The intense shame of regretting getting the puppy and feeling like a bad person.
Feeling trapped in the house, unable to run errands or leave for work without a panic attack.
The puppy's crying causing massive fights with a partner at 3 AM over whose turn it is.
The physiological spike in the owner's own heart rate when the puppy starts screaming.
The fear of neighbors complaining about the noise or judging them for having an out-of-control dog.
The betrayal of 'expert' advice telling them to just let the puppy cry it out, which only makes it worse.

held: Puppy training means sacrificing sleep and sanity for 6 months
I have to drug my dog with CBD to get any peace
ready_to_shift: Crate anxiety is a biological cortisol spike that can be naturally lowered with amino acids, not harsh sedatives or cruel ignoring.
